text:
jamie chen: NimbleHealth POC wrapped. short bursts look good, but sustained long-context runs consumed way more tokens than they forecast. they want pricing rebaseline before renewal next week.

alex ramos: numbers? qps / 90p / token burn?

jamie chen: POC: 500 qps burst, 90p=180ms, sustained sim ~60 qps -> ~1.2B tokens over 14 days. they planned ~400M.

maria singh: that's ~3x. suggest staged commit uplift: 1.5B tokens for 12 months with stepped discount (15% q1, 10% thereafter) + safety buffer. needs deal desk for nonstandard tier.

oliver park: they also submitted a security questionnaire (SSO + HIPAA). legal flagged data residency clause; that'll affect willingness to sign a year commit.

jamie chen: timeline: negotiations start Mon. need pricing + legal OK by EOD Fri.

dealbot: current ratecard link: https://redwood.example/sales/ratecards/current. recommended calc: recommended_commit = ceil(observed_usage * 1.25) -> 1.5B tokens.

maria singh: propose a $25k one-time migration credit conditional on signed 12-mo commit to mitigate overage concerns.

legal-bot: migration credit needs: amount, application window (90 days), refund policy, and Legal signoff. also need decision on residency clause.

alex ramos: compact deal desk summary to submit: Customer: NimbleHealth; Current commit: 500M/yr; Observed: 1.2B/14d; Proposed commit: 1.5B/yr; Blended discount ~12%; One-time credit $25k; Conditions: residency approved or fallback to encrypted-in-transit only.

cs_lead: opening deal desk ticket now. tagging @maria singh for discount memo and @legal-bot for amendment. ETA 2h.

maria singh: will attach POC metrics and discount rationale. recommend canary traffic shift during rollout. :thumbsup: 

oliver park: note: if residency can't be met, customer may want VPC/private deployment; that triggers a different pricing bucket.

jamie chen: action items: cs_lead -> create ticket + attach artifacts; maria -> discount memo + uplift calc; legal-bot -> amendment draft + residency options; alex -> ARR impact calc; oliver -> VPC pricing delta.

alex ramos: happy to join the renewal call Tue to walk through the math.

jamie chen: thanks team. will update after Deal Desk response. :white_check_mark:
